# Mann Patel

> Independent web designer based in Scarborough, Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Builds websites, sets up local SEO and Google Business Profiles, and connects enquiry follow-up and online booking for small service businesses in Toronto and the GTA. All prices are published, in Canadian dollars, plus applicable tax.

## Services and prices (CAD, plus tax)
- Website Fix: $450 to $850. One defined problem on an existing site, fixed and checked against an agreed test.
- Website Launch: $1,950. Up to five pages, one enquiry path, the client's own text and photos, two rounds of revisions. Paid half at kickoff, half once launch checks pass.
- Website + Enquiry System: $3,350. Everything in Website Launch, plus one booking integration and one defined follow-up workflow. The extra $1,400 over Website Launch buys one booking integration plus one workflow.
- Local Visibility Setup: $650. One eligible Google Business Profile, a short named list of other listings, a review routine and a before-and-after snapshot.
- Website Care: $149 a month. A monthly test enquiry, booking link check, up to 30 minutes of edits and a note. Cancel any month.
Domain, hosting and tool subscriptions are billed to the client directly by each provider.

## Where I work
Based in Scarborough. Working across Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area, including Scarborough and North York.

## Who it's for
Small service businesses such as cleaning companies, salons and spas, and other local trades.
